title: 第13章【冥婚】险象环生
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

话音未落，那些水草疯狂地朝着顾原的口中涌入，几乎是瞬间他的嘴里便被水草塞满，已经无法呼吸，但这还没有完。

那些水草顺着他的嗓子眼还在往下钻，整个胃里只觉得快要被撑得爆炸，每一秒都能感受到撕心裂肺的疼痛。

剧烈的疼痛让顾原的五官几乎都扭曲起来，但他没有放弃，手中的铜钱剑发疯似的朝着那些水草砍去，但效果却微乎其微，那些被砍断的水草不出片刻，再次涌了上来。

很快，顾原的意识在黑暗中一寸一寸的消散。

此刻他能明显的感觉到，自己的身体被大量的水草占据，似乎只有自己的大脑还没有沦陷，还有自己的意识。

铜钱剑还在不断的挥舞着，但手臂已经没了力气，罗小娟那张惨白的脸就隐匿在水草中间，不时的露出两只充满怨愤的眼睛死死地盯着顾原。

她以一个及其诡异阴森的方式张开了嘴，口中没有任何东西，什么舌头牙齿通通没有，只有密密麻麻无数的水草。

“去死......去死......去死......”

罗小娟的声音不在是小孩的童真，而是无数个重叠在一起的低语，像是几十个人同时在他的耳边呢喃，每一个音节都像是一根银针一样狠狠地刺进了他的大脑。

顾原的视线开始模糊，眼前的水草、罗小娟的脸都开始模糊，最后通通消失在黑暗中。

要死了吗？

这个念头像是一盆冰水狠狠地浇在他的心头，他想起来西装男那张令人恐惧的脸，想起来盘子中罗小娟的脑袋，那张充满害怕深色的脸。

不，我不能死。

我不能死在这里。

再度睁开眼，罗小娟那张阴森的脸就出现在自己的面前，只不过正在好奇的打量着自己，刚才自己没有半点反应，或许在罗小娟看来自己已经死了，所以她才敢这么放心大胆的出现在面前。

抓住机会，顾原用尽全身力气，将手中的铜钱剑狠狠地刺进了罗小娟的身体里。

“啊！”

罗小娟顿时发出了撕心裂肺的惨叫，水草像是被火烧到了一样疯狂地收缩，从顾原的口中喉咙甚至是胃里猛地抽出来。

那种感觉比起之前钻进自己的身体还要痛苦百倍，他感觉自己的五脏六腑甚至都要被水草连带着撤出来。

外面，缠绕在顾原身上的水草疯了一般的扭动着，以飞快的速度从自己的身上如同潮水一样退了下去。

那些水草在顾原的面前不断地扭动，紧接着就缩到了一处，而顾原这时才惊恐地发现，这些水草竟然变成了一个人形，而罗小娟的那张脸正稳稳地镶嵌在上面。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Before he finished speaking, the water plants rushed towards Gu Yuan's mouth crazily. Almost instantly, his mouth was filled with water plants and he could no longer breathe, but it was not over yet.

Those water plants were still burrowing down his throat, and his whole stomach felt like it was about to explode, and he could feel the heartbreaking pain every second.

The severe pain almost distorted Gu Yuan's facial features, but he did not give up. The copper coin sword in his hand slashed at the water plants like crazy, but the effect was minimal. Within a moment, the chopped water plants came up again.

Soon, Gu Yuan's consciousness dissipated inch by inch in the darkness.

At this moment, he could clearly feel that his body was occupied by a large number of water plants. It seemed that only his brain had not collapsed and he still had his own consciousness.

The copper coin sword was still waving, but the strength of her arm was gone. Luo Xiaojuan's pale face was hidden among the water plants, and from time to time, two eyes full of resentment were revealed to stare at Gu Yuan.

She opened her mouth in an extremely weird and eerie way. There was nothing in her mouth, no tongue or teeth, only dense and numerous water plants.

"Go to hell...go to hell...go to hell..."

Luo Xiaojuan's voice was no longer the innocence of a child, but countless overlapping whispers, like dozens of people whispering in his ears at the same time, each syllable piercing his brain like a silver needle.

Gu Yuan's vision began to blur, and the water plants in front of him and Luo Xiaojuan's face began to blur, and finally disappeared into the darkness.

Dying?

This thought was like a basin of ice water pouring on his heart. He thought of the frightening face of the man in the suit, and of Luo Xiaojuan's head on the plate, with that dark face full of fear.

No, I can't die.

I can't die here.

Opening her eyes again, Luo Xiaojuan's gloomy face appeared in front of her, but she was looking at herself curiously. She didn't react at all just now. Maybe she was dead in Luo Xiaojuan's eyes, so she dared to appear in front of her so confidently.

Seizing the opportunity, Gu Yuan used all his strength to stab the copper coin sword in his hand into Luo Xiaojuan's body.

"Ah!"

Luo Xiaojuan suddenly let out a heart-rending scream, and the waterweed shrank crazily as if it was burned, and was violently pulled out of Gu Yuan's mouth, throat and even stomach.

That feeling was a hundred times more painful than when it entered his body before. He felt like his internal organs were about to be pulled out together with the water plants.

Outside, the water plants wrapped around Gu Yuan's body were twisting like crazy, and receded from his body like a tide at a very fast speed.

The water plants kept twisting in front of Gu Yuan, and then shrank into one place. Only then did Gu Yuan discover to his horror that the water plants turned into a human shape, and Luo Xiaojuan's face was firmly embedded in it.
